title: Choose the first page
summary: DirectoryIndex lists candidate files for a directory request. The first existing suitable file can be used.
introduction: DirectoryIndex lists candidate files for a directory request. The first existing suitable file can be used. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: DirectoryIndex lists candidate files for a directory request. The first existing suitable file can be used.
A visitor opening the directory can receive index.html. The directive does not generate the file.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a minimal index.html for a club.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A missing index file is not a reason to expose private directory contents.
For more detail later, use this [Apache HTTP Server further reading](https://httpd.apache.org/docs/2.4/getting-started.html).
